notes.title: LOCATION VOTE & development report: Factory
notes.content:
VOTE!
We ready to finally ask how you want fourth location to look? Give your opinion in Google form by link below or vote on our Discord or both to increase chances of winning! From now you will have 2 weeks to vote.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeuBDhgRP38MtfXFbd27ujoqSnK1d1wxRszrfqqUI23cNoDQA/viewform?usp=header
DONE
By now Factory location done for 40% we may even be a little ahead of schedule but time will show. For exemple here is a screen of secret level. Work in progress.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690615/37eb5fab105f039f01f6d86d9c0ae1ce2dce30d8.png"]

As you can see no noticeable graphic improvements here.
Levels
Overall it's noticible harder to deliver original ideas but we still do! You will notice this right on first level of new location. I can't say that we matching a Desert by the size but we took best from them and made it better. I think we came to solid level structure overall like 1 Unique mechanic 1 Not-cooperative parkour 1 Strongly co-op 1 Puzzle, Boss fight and Silly secret level.
Death screen
Now there will be a proper death screen(picture below) that will be different if cause of game over is your friend! See for yourself.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690615/597737bb4649eddc23bb298b131c5d3a93ad23b2.png"]

While working with this I found a bug! Looks like there where a problem and in reality players shared their health. So it's now should be better.
Free game
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690615/79b2cf57a7be93555681356c4cfa7a4ef641257a.png"]

Some time ago we made a pretty solid and complete game for a 3-day game jam. You can play it for free on Itch.io https://stanlatt.itch.io/clone-out please enjoy. It was fun and we learned a few new tricks but not sure about repeating it :) Some kind of type 2 fun.
PLANSLocalization
In upcoming update we are planning to add a poorly localized support for German, French, Spanish and Portuguese(Brazil). I promise if we will have additional resourses to hire someone with actual knowledge of this beutiful languages it will be done.
BOSS FIGHT
Main amount of work we putting to combine experience gained from previous fights and deliver something even more smooth and dynamic, like a well prepared dance. Maybe game would be better if we made only boss fights... Let's just say this time it will be something what you can see above while in factory.

notes.title: Sand is settled, new patch appears
notes.content:
Hello hello, thank you for your support and attentionNew week new patch, it won't be like this always but now emplimanting your feedback.Rebalance
Now spike parkour on Level 3 will be easier. Platforms will stay active twice more time so you can coordinate better (it was possible before btw)

Added a hint so you can better understand an ending puzzle on level 4

Added an explanation on apple usage

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690615/a2afdd169b612bb3b200f78b0a314467e2f3ad2f.gif"]
Bugs
FINALLY arrow now ALWAYS switch players!!!! Almost...there is still sometimes occurs problems when ping is high, around 300+ms. Or one time I caught a moment when it disappears at all, but restart helps. BUT now it happens so rarely that you should think that you're lucky if this happens to you :)

Second secret level now works
Improvements and additions
Performance improvements overall but especially for Desert location. We optimized models and light. In future planing to add a "disable shadows" option.

More decorations around Castle (first) location, so you fell more at home

Slightly changed arrow trajectory, now feels more controllable. Also it less likely to go through wall is you shoot it near it.

Now Knight boss fight includes one more element, when it hits a wall, candelabras fall from ceiling and cause a dangerous fire!!!! Boss battle is much more entertaining now.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690615/1b4637ee65915439cb65fd707212bfc311f3a0fa.png"][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=--F-ghJipD0"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Hotfix 16.08.2025
notes.content:
Ooopsie forgot to unlock level 2, before you just skiped to level 3 from 1. Now you can transit to it trough level 1 propeerly

Worm boss is now better

Skeletons now detect second player properly. I missed a -0.3 Y so ray casted above player...

Some minor sound improvments

notes.title: Desert, Festival and Early Access
notes.content:
FIRST, NEW LOCATION AND UPDATE!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690615/32efd4d21bc4da243e0ca76a9675d44991edd8e5.png"]
Added:
4 new levels

2 new secret levels. One for Castle, second for brand new Desert

1 New boss battle and a little rework of Weaponless knight with performance issue fixes

5 new soundtracks

Updated size of UI

Achivments

pepper and camel
Fixed:
Bug when arrow flight through a target without triggering it

Bug with respawn in waiting lobby

Bug with non-stoping main menu music when invited trough Steam

Bug when doors don't open on level 4 even if puzzle solved right

Bug with hitbox of enemies, problems to shoot them from above

and more smaller ones...
Second, festival!
I can proudly say that 2b1a is taking part in Ukrainian Games Festival 2025. To be honest it's a pleasure to stand together with other great projects. So with this we also launch a 10% discount!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690615/0c07b1fbc34c8ba0bd23161b209963d598dba91e.png"]Third, early access!*delayed... sorry but due to technical reasons it will only be available in a few days ːcaptainclownː
Yes, starting from now You can get more game with our innovative subscription model! YOU pay ONES and then RECIVE FREE UPDATES according to roadmap until game enters version 1.0 and maybe(no promisec) something after. So what will You say? Great deal right? 

Roadmap can be found on Steam store page. Information about what already in game can be found on there too. In few words 5 locations with different unique levels, on release there be a total of 20 regular levels, 5 Bosses and at least 5 secret levels.
Thank you for attention, follow on blsky for smaller updates about development!

notes.title: Post-demo launch update
notes.content:
Since launch of Demo 2b1a reached 100 wishlists! Thank you ❤


This update for Demo do not change gameplay features but improves performance significantly! Both hardware and net.

+30 fps on average due to models optimization

Upgraded light and shadows

No more "Arrow not switching" bug (hopefully)

Finally nice main menu

Little tweaks to make playing better for exempel when host exits game now it close for client too
What next?
Well Desert location is done for 60% but hardest part is only to be done. Boss battle... I won't spoiler who it will be yet, but you can try and guess in comments.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690615/5f0818985bcdcc084173f49178a526131db1f671.png"]

After completion of 2nd level pack game will enter Early access! Maybe... So this is part where I need YOUR opinion. Lately I heard a lot of negatity about all this early access thing but I feel like main issues are can be solved very nicely with our model of updates and won't conflict with player expirience that much. So you won't lose any significant portion of game when new levels come out. What I mean by that is that there is no need to return back to first location when new comes out becouse every level pack is developet separatly. Maybe there is other problems so that is why I am asking. 
Also you'll see a new cinematic trailer hopefully soon! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690615/85550f5d5415863bb6ddb79ba841a84be03c7cde.gif"]
